_readme: Trend signals the agent may use as inspiration (format/angle/sound), never as content to copy. Add entries from TikTok Creative Center, Pinterest, Instagram etc. 'format' maps to a content format id (poster-reveal, on-this-day, quiz, last-minute, framed-vs-frameless, collection-pick, design-breakdown). Remove or set 'expires' when a trend is over.

trends.title: Photo carousels with a question hook on slide 1 and the answer on a later slide
trends.notes: General carousel pattern; no specific sound required

trends.title: Gallery walls with framed sports prints (room inspiration)
trends.notes: Angle: how a poster looks with or without a frame
